explication: ZXing-C++ is a C++ barcode image-processing library for reading and writing linear and matrix symbologies, with bindings for multiple languages and platforms. The principal read flow accepts an in-memory image and reader options, locates and decodes supported symbols, then returns Barcode results; writing creates a barcode from content and renders it as an image, SVG, or text. The graph preserves the documented format families and wrapper capability. Sampled source is limited, so some links reflect the documented API and module responsibilities rather than inspected call sites.
